name: Sayadaw U Vivekananda
reason: Too thin and no usable photo: Panditarama Lumbini's site (where he is resident teacher) was last updated around 2017, its only photo of him is 190×250 px, its 'up-to-date' Google site redirects to a sign-in page (not pursued), and apart from the centre's year-round retreat there are no current items of his own (his books are translations of Sayadaw U Pandita's talks).
